t: The gray man who arrived in the fifth dimension

b.x: There is no map to get there

Whoever looks for the fifth dimension the way one looks for a city has already left the path. It is not a sky after death. It is not a planet. It is not a secret room. It is a degree of consciousness. In the narrow degree, you are the story: the name, the offense, the fear, the role. Life happens to you, and you run after it. In the wide degree, you are the consciousness in which the story appears. Life happens through you. The gray man who arrived did not leave the street. He left the confusion. He is still discreet. Discretion stopped being flight and became form. Inside, he is no longer tight inside the character. That is arriving. The place is the same. The point from which one looks is what rose.
Three degrees, so you do not fool yourself

The dense degree is this: I am the body, I am the story, the world does things to me. Everything is separate. The other is threat or audience. The thought is fact. Whoever lives there is not wrong. He is identified. The middle degree is the restless awakening. You have already seen that the mind makes the film. You no longer believe everything. And you still swing. You rise one day, you fall the next, and you call both identity. Many people stop here and think they have arrived, because they already have the words. The fifth degree is different. Consciousness recognizes itself as consciousness, in the middle of an ordinary day, without an audience. The thought passes and does not sit in the chair. The feeling passes and does not become a house. The person goes on loving, working, being quiet, choosing. He only does not reduce himself to what is passing. Whoever is truly in that degree does not need you to believe him. Width does not ask for a witness.

It is not the one who says the name of the dimension the most. The name is cheap. Whoever arrived is recognized by situations, not by speech. He may be in a simple room. He may be quiet in a conversation where everyone wants to win. His consciousness does not climb down in order to win. He feels. He is not stone. The difference is that the feeling does not govern the verb. He does not correct the room in order to be seen correcting. He does not tell his own light. Near him, the room becomes less tight, and he does not charge for that. If he charges, he has not arrived: there is still an I wanting the master's place. The highest degree, seen from outside, looks simple. Ordinary. In no hurry to prove. The gray man and that degree do not fight. The gray coat hides the excess. Wide consciousness is what was underneath, when the coat stops being skin.

Expansion is not an idea you study and store. It is a situation you recognize. The offense arrives. The old sentence rises, ready, with the usual voice. And you see it rise. You do not become the sentence. The room continues. You stayed larger than the sentence. That is a degree. Fear arrives, real, in the body. You do not pretend you do not feel it. You also do not hand the rest of the day to it. You see fear as a visitor. The house is the one who sees. That is another degree. A memory pulls you toward an age that has already passed. You notice: I am seeing the memory. I am not the age of it. The past is inside the now. Time stops being a line that drags you and becomes a field you witness. You want to be the man who knows. You notice the hunger to announce. And you do not announce. The knowing stays. The hunger leaves without an audience. That is arrival, more than any pretty sentence. Joy appears without a reason, small, with no effort of a smile. You do not run after it. You recognize that you are the space in which it appeared. Loss arrives. The pain is true. You do not call it low in order to skip out. You hold it without manufacturing an I named pain. To expand includes. It does not decorate. It does not flee.
Sentences of one who is no longer tight

Whoever is in that degree does not make a speech. If he speaks, the sentence is short, and it does not ask for applause. I am not in the fifth. The fifth is how much I stop mistaking myself for what passes. Consciousness does not go anywhere. It notices that it never left. Fear is a visitor. The house is what sees the visitor. To expand is not to know more. It is to be less tight. What I contemplate, I feed. I contemplate width, not the theater. I have thoughts. I am not the thoughts. I am what perceives. The other is not the role he is playing. He is consciousness, sometimes contracted. I do not climb down to fit inside his contraction. I also do not climb up to humiliate. Pain fits. The I of pain does not need to be founded. I create from what I am, not from what I fear to be. And I do not announce. Whoever needs to announce is still on the way. The announcement belongs to the I that wants to arrive ahead of the others. Whoever arrived no longer runs that race.
The field in which everything appears

In the wide degree, time is not a line. It is a field. What you call the past is an image now. What you call the future is an image now. Both appear in the same consciousness that is reading this sentence. This does not cancel the clock of the house. It cancels the hypnosis that you are only a point being pushed. You take part. The intention, the feeling you sustain, and the small step are causes. The universe is not a wall. It is an answer to the degree you insist on being. If you insist on fear, the answer comes as more narrowness. If you insist on presence, the answer comes as more space. It is not a prize. It is correspondence. The gray man who arrived stopped begging the effect. He tends the cause that is in his hand: the sentence he contemplates, the degree he feeds, the step he does not announce. The rest of the field rearranges itself. Slowly. Without theater.

It is not thinking yourself above people. Above is another tightness, only with vocabulary. It is not abandoning the ones you love in order to look free. Love fits in the wide degree. What does not fit is need. It is not calling pain an illusion in order not to feel it. That is flight with a pretty name. It is not repeating words until the room gets tired. The word without the degree is fantasy. It is not vanishing from your own life. The gray man who arrived is not invisible to himself. He is invisible to the excess. He eats. He cares. He is quiet. He chooses the step. The difference is that none of these things defines him. He is the consciousness in which they happen. Whoever reads this and only collects the sentence is still in the middle degree, and that is all right. The middle is honest. Arrival begins in the next real situation, when the sentence rises and you remain the one who sees.
